name: Default
shortDescription: Personal archive that organizes photos, messages, location history, social media and contacts into one searchable timeline.

alerts.message: Timelinize has no login of its own, so the template puts it behind HTTP basic auth: sign in with TIMELINIZE_USERNAME and TIMELINIZE_PASSWORD from the environment variables.

On first visit, create the timeline in /repo so it is stored on the persistent volume. The import file picker only sees the container filesystem, so copy your data exports into that volume before importing.
Timelinize is pre-release software and its schema can change between versions. Keep your original data exports so you can rebuild the timeline after an upgrade.
